articles.title: Trump-promoted brand touts GOLD before token collapse
articles.snippet: Real Trump Coins promoted GOLD before deleting related X posts, while team-linked wallets sold 224.5 million tokens as its market value fell about 99%.

articles.title: Abu Dhabi royal backs 49% stake in Trump-linked crypto bank venture: WSJ
articles.snippet: Sheikh Tahnoon’s group reportedly backs a 49% stake in the holding company behind World Liberty’s conditionally approved US trust bank.

articles.title: Trump cost investors $4.7B through crypto ‘schemes’: Public Citizen
articles.snippet: While investors in World Liberty Financial‘s USD1 stablecoin “haven’t suffered major losses,” many lost billions of dollars in other Trump ventures, according to Public Citizen.

articles.title: Judge Rules Trump Administration Illegally Retaliated Against Anthropic Over AI Red Lines
articles.snippet: Rita Lin vacated the supply chain designation and issued a permanent injunction, refusing the government even a seven-day stay.
